verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software platform, so user-defined event-triggered automation rules are outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability: its online investor-readiness check tool and cap table downloads are not rule-based automation, and the probes found no API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
